# SDK 1.0.0-rc.30

Public SDK reference and examples for this release.

`api.json`: complete release catalog; optional APIs require explicit module selection.
`base/api.json`: headless core reference; no optional module or UI renderer APIs.
`packages.json`: exact package pins; `packages/<unscoped-package>/<version>/api.json`: public snapshots.
`base/sdk-methods.lock.json`: methods from the same base graph. Next-LTS producer format;
this does not enable independent releases or claim MCP/Projects consumer adoption.
`modules.json`: released module manifests, settings and configuration schemas.
